TextDraw Anti-Aliasing Fix v{version}
https://github.com/sonochiwa/sa-textdraw-anti-aliasing-fix

GTA San Andreas 1.0 US plugin for SA-MP. Requires an ASI loader.

Installation
  Extract TextDrawAntiAliasingFix.asi and TextDrawAntiAliasingFix.ini into
  the game directory or its scripts directory, then start the game.

Created by sonochiwa. MIT license.
